thread:
harper: Quick preflight for NimbusWorks integration. They want LangChain orchestration -> LlamaIndex retrieval -> our gateway -> Dedicated pool. Also asked about an OrchX plugin and a marketplace bundle. Can we confirm owners and a minimal safe timeline?

nico: I can validate the LangChain + LlamaIndex notebooks and check multi-tenant ingestion behavior. ETA: smoke run by Tue noon.

sadaf: Ops/infra: need to know if Nimbus will use streaming. If yes we should test tail-token stability on Dedicated; propose Tue 02:00-03:00 UTC maintenance for a small gateway tweak. Also they have a nonstandard cert chain in staging.

eli: Ill own the OrchX adapter prototype and marketplace tile copy. If OrchX calls us server-side we need a webhook-to-stream shim. Ill sketch the shim this afternoon.

mkt-bot: Reminder: co-marketing requires a signed addendum. Filing COANN-3300.

harper: Good. Primary risks: cert chain, tenant key collisions in LlamaIndex, streaming flakiness. NICO/SADAF please confirm blockers.

nico: Found a potential vector store key collision when concurrent OrchX jobs run ingestion. Proposed namespace change: ```python
# tenant-aware key
def lindex_key(tenant, item_id):
    return f"nimbus:{tenant}:{item_id}"
```

sadaf: Ops: we can do the gateway push in the proposed window. If Nimbus cannot provide the PEM chain we will proxy their staging traffic for the demo. Ill open PARTNER-3301 for cert acceptance.

eli: Shim prototype note: OrchX sends a task callback; shim will POST to /v1/stream with a small envelope. Will add retry/backoff for webhook delivery. Posting repo link soon.

harper: Marketing/legal: Chris will handle co-marketing assets; @legal-bot please start review. Were aiming for internal dry run Wed 09:00 and partner demo Wed 14:00; move if legal not ready.

legal-bot: COANN-3300 created and assigned to @chris. Typical turnaround 48-72h.

nico: Also adding a quick LangChain tool-calling stream test: ```bash
curl -N -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/stream \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_DEV" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-stream-01","input":"run tool:extract_entities"}'
```

sadaf: Ops rollback: revert gateway routing and re-route traffic to fallback model if errors spike >1% in 3m. Will post runbook once maintenance is scheduled.

eli: Ill also prepare a short demo script highlighting OrchX integration points and the marketplace bundle contents (plugin, adapter, 3 sample notebooks).

harper: Action recap: Nico -> smoke tests + LlamaIndex namespacing (owner), Sadaf -> cert ticket + maintenance window + runbook (owner), Eli -> OrchX shim + repo + deploy checklist (owner), Chris -> co-marketing draft & attach to COANN-3300 (owner). Ill sync with Nimbus PM on timezones.

mkt-bot: COANN-3300 updated: draft slides requested.

harper: Thanks team. Keep updates short here; if anything blocks the demo move it ASAP. :white_check_mark:
